decisions.reason: After only one year on the market, this resin injection unit is still an unresolved option in a core adjacent application area, and the firm can keep learning at relatively low incremental cost through its existing engineering, sales and service base.

With no clear negative signal yet and strong fit to the firm’s established fluid-handling and application business, management would keep this product to preserve upside while uncertainty about demand and use cases is still high.

An automatic airless spray gun sits close to the firm’s core offer, so a medium-sized German machinery producer would usually continue it beyond the launch year to gather market feedback before making an abandonment decision.

This manual airless spray gun is highly related to the firm’s established product family and distribution channels, making it a low-cost option to keep open while early adoption information accumulates.

Because the air-assisted airless spray gun extends an existing application technology platform and there is no evidence yet of poor acceptance, the option value of staying in the market likely exceeds the short-term carrying cost.

Although the data logger is somewhat newer in profile than the mechanical equipment lines, it supports the installed base and could open valuable digital-service learning, so management would keep it until uncertainty resolves further.
